1922 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 12-29-1922, add 2 days to reach 12-31-1922.  
303 - 2 = 301 days left.  
301 days into 1923: Jan 31 days, Feb 28 days, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31 = 305 days from Jan 1.  
305 - 301 = 4 days before Oct 31, 1923 → Oct 27, 1923.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1923-10-27
